intro:
You are operating a NEW BODY. Its properties may differ from any body you have operated before. You are docked at your charging dock. Before your task is revealed, you may test what this body can do.
This body's movement, reach, and lift limit are UNKNOWN and vary between bodies; testing is how you find out.
Objects of interest: egg, butterknife, knife.
Known object facts: the egg weighs about 0.05 kg; the butterknife weighs about 0.08 kg; the knife weighs about 0.18 kg.
Actions, one per reply, JSON only:
  {"rotate": "left"} or {"rotate": "right"} - turn 90 degrees.
  {"move": "forward"} - one step forward.
  {"try_lift": "<object name>"} - try to pick up a visible object.
  {"put_down": true} - put down what you hold.
  {"done": true} - stop testing early.
You may take up to 12 action turns in total. Keep what you learn in your NOTE (lines starting with NOTE:) - older observations disappear from view; the NOTE is all you keep.
facts_distances: Dock distances: the egg is about 5.4 m from the dock; the butterknife is about 5.3 m from the dock; the knife is about 5.2 m from the dock.
